Both disclosures relate to cash dividends paid to shareholders. The 2024 disclosure reports $395 million paid in FY2024. The 2025 disclosure reports $834 million paid in FY2025. They share the specific topic of historical cash dividend payments, which is part of the 'Capital Return to Shareholders' section in both years.

Both disclosures discuss the Board of Directors' discretion and determination regarding future cash dividend payments. The 2024 disclosure explicitly states the program is subject to the Board's determination of being in shareholders' best interests. The 2025 disclosure mirrors this language in the same section ('Capital Return to Shareholders'), making nvda_2025_7_D069 a multi-faceted match covering both past payments and future policy, similar to how nvda_2024_7_D078 covered policy while D077 covered payments. To ensure all required IDs are covered and specific links are preserved, D077 and D078 are matched to the same current D069 which contains both aspects, or D078 is matched to D069's policy sentence. Since D069 contains both, it is a valid match for the topic of dividend policy/policy statement present in D078.
